messages:
Sam (Sales): Customer POC hitting 403 on /v1/embeddings. Error: "project missing or not bound to key". They used a service-account key we generated. Demo in 48h.
Rina (SE): Can you paste the exact curl they ran and the key id (sa_ vs sk_)?
Sam (Sales): They sent: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_pocxyz' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-mini","input":"test"}'
```
Rina (SE): Two likely causes: missing x-redwood-org/project headers for cross-tenant routing, or the SA key has no project binding/scopes. Ask them to retry with: `-H 'x-redwood-org: org_demo' -H 'x-redwood-project: proj_demo'`.
Kai (Infra): infra-log: req=plk-77 status=403 code=project_unbound key=sa_pocxyz region=us-west-2
Kai (Infra): I can repro. Quick fixes: 1) reprovision bound SA key scoped to embeddings.generate with short expiry; 2) use a short-lived user sk_ token (requires portal auth). For demo, option 1 is faster.
Elliot (Security): For the questionnaire: recommend short-lived keys for POCs, we provide audit logs of key creation/binding/rotation and KMS wrapping options for Private deployments. I'll draft a one-paragraph answer.
Rina (SE): I'll provision a 72-hour bound SA key and put the secret into 1Password. I'll post the key id here (not the secret) and give the customer the curl with headers.
Sam (Sales): Thanks — I'll tell them to retry and paste response headers if they still see 403. Also tell them to run `curl -I` to capture edge-req-id.
AuthBot: event: key_provisioned id=sa_poc_bound_72h tenant=proj_demo scopes=[embeddings.generate] created_by=rina.se expiry=2026-06-05T09:00:00Z
Sam (Sales): Closing loop once customer confirms.
